tasks.description: Use when asked to draft a support response grounded in approved policy and knowledge. Not for sending replies or approving refunds.
tasks.example: Draft a support response grounded in approved policy and knowledge.
phrases: draft a support response grounded in approved policy and knowledge
method: Use the selected case, approved knowledge and service policy; retain uncertainty about unverified causes.
Acknowledge the actual problem without admitting unsupported liability or promising unavailable remedies.
Give clear, safe next steps and request only necessary missing information.
Review recipients, sensitive content and commitments; deliver an editable draft without sending it.
checks: Instructions are supported by current material
No invented refund, timeline or resolution
No secrets requested or repeated
stopConditions: The answer requires unverified account access
Policy and requested remedy conflict
tasks.exclusions: Not for sending replies or approving refunds.

tasks.title: Support knowledge proposal
tasks.description: Use when asked to propose a reusable support article from selected resolved cases. Not for promoting every conversation into approved knowledge.
tasks.example: Propose a reusable support article from selected resolved cases.
phrases: propose a reusable support article from selected resolved cases
method: Confirm what the case evidence actually establishes; a proposed fix is not a verified resolution.
Identify the applicable versions, symptoms, prerequisites and known limitations.
Draft reproducible safe steps with exact evidence links and escalation conditions.
Search existing knowledge before proposing a new page; prepare a wiki draft or change proposal through existing review.
checks: Unverified fixes are labelled
Private customer details are removed from reusable text
No automatic wiki publication
stopConditions: Resolution is not evidenced
Steps require unsafe or unauthorized access
tasks.exclusions: Not for promoting every conversation into approved knowledge.
